target: Add a read-only workspace config schema and resolver for locating dope-agent-system through explicit path, environment variable, or .dopetask/workspace.yaml without hardcoded paths, CLI commands, dependency changes, runner changes, or dope-agent-system writes.
invariants: dope-agent-system remains asset/template/reference authority only; this packet performs no dope-agent-system writes or inspection.
PAL/clink remains planning/context only and is not execution transport.
This packet is workspace resolver foundation only.

Do not implement dopetask ui status, dopetask report, dopetask cockpit, Asset Library, DAS preview/listing UI, runner health changes, runner implementation changes, adapter behavior changes, or routing scoring changes.

Do not add textual, dependencies, pyproject.toml changes, uv.lock changes, CLI commands, subprocess calls, network calls, dopetask doctor invocations, dopetask route plan invocations, or Task Packet execution.
Do not create or modify a real .dopetask/workspace.yaml in the repository; tests may create temporary fixtures under tmp_path only.
The resolver must return None cleanly when no explicit path, environment path, or workspace config path exists.
Source and tests for this packet must not contain machine-local path fallbacks.

commit.message: feat(workspace): add explicit DAS path resolver
verify: grep -R "import textual\|from textual" src/dopetask tests || true
grep -R "dopetask doctor\|route plan\|tp series exec" src/dopetask/workspace.py tests/test_workspace.py || true

pr.title: Add workspace DAS path resolver
pr.body: Adds the workspace config schema and read-only resolver for explicit, environment, or workspace.yaml DAS path discovery.

steps.task: Inspect accepted dependency proof, Opus design artifacts, task-packet schema, existing YAML loader usage, and existing UI runner health tests before editing.
requirements: Treat dopeTask runtime code as authority.
Treat Opus design artifacts as design authority for workspace discovery boundaries.
Treat dopetask_schemas/task_packet.schema.json as packet shape authority.

steps.task: Create dopetask_schemas/workspace.schema.json and src/dopetask/workspace.py with a read-only resolver for explicit, environment, primary workspace, alias workspace, and None precedence.
requirements: Reject malformed YAML, non-object YAML, non-string path fields, unsupported top-level keys, and conflicting path aliases.
Resolve relative paths against repo_root, expand home paths, and never require the resolved path to exist.
Default das_path_env_override to DOPE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PATH when absent.
Do not write files or inspect dope-agent-system.

steps.task: Add focused resolver tests, create proof and implementer report artifacts, run validation commands, and commit only allowlisted files if clean.
requirements: Tests must use tmp_path fixtures for workspace.yaml.

Tests must prove missing config returns None, explicit path wins, env wins, primary and alias fields resolve, relative and home paths normalize, custom env override works, invalid config raises, path existence is not required, and packet source/tests contain no machine-local path literals.
Proof must record validation exit codes and self-referential commit hash caveat.
